### `add_guest_to_folder`

**Add Guest To Folder** · `POST /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/guest/{guest_id}` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Share a Folder with a guest.

***Note:** This endpoint is only available to Workspaces on our [Enterprise Plan](https://clickup.com/pricing).*

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `guest_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `include_shared` | query | boolean |  | Exclude details of items shared with the guest by setting this parameter to `false`. By default this parameter is set to `true`. |

### `invite_guest_to_workspace`

**Invite Guest To Workspace** · `POST /api/v2/team/{team_id}/guest` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Invite a guest to join a Workspace. To invite a member to your Workspace, use the [Invite User to Workspace](users.md#invite_user_to_workspace) endpoint.

You'll also need to grant the guest access to specific items using the following endpoints: [Add Guest to Folder](#add_guest_to_folder), [Add Guest to List](#add_guest_to_list), or [Add Guest to Task](#add_guest_to_task).

***Note:** This endpoint is only available to Workspaces on our [Enterprise Plan](https://clickup.com/pricing).*

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_id` | path | number | yes | Workspace ID |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (7)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | yes |  |
| `can_edit_tags` | boolean |  |  |
| `can_see_time_spent` | boolean |  |  |
| `can_see_time_estimated` | boolean |  |  |
| `can_create_views` | boolean |  |  |
| `can_see_points_estimated` | boolean |  |  |
| `custom_role_id` | integer |  |  |

</details>
